name: Talisman of Enchantment II
description: Drag onto a single unequipped weapon of grade 50 to 59 to reset and reroll OTP, Attack/Magic and Explosive Blow.#n10% chance of the next lower grade; 5% chance of the next higher grade. Imperial weapons stay Imperial.#nEach OTP and Attack/Magic stage is rolled independently; the last successful stage wins.#nOTP: +1 (50%), +2 (40%), +3 (20%), +4 (10%), +5 (5%).#nAttack/Magic: +1 to +16 with 1 to 10 EB; rarest result: +16 with 16 EB.#nExisting enchantments can become worse. Consumes one talisman.
